metadata.description: Phase Execution Workflow (PEW) — precision delivery for Claude Code

plugins.name: pew
plugins.description: 7-step delivery loop with YAML tracking, quality gates, council review, and sub-agents

plugins.name: pew-doc
plugins.description: Generate comprehensive application documentation from codebase analysis — product overview, architecture, internals, API contracts, and data models

plugins.name: pew-groom
plugins.description: Automated technical grooming — multi-phase issue analysis against actual code across multiple repositories

plugins.name: pew-prompt-audit
plugins.description: Prompt quality audit — multi-phase analysis of prompt, agent, and skill definitions for defects, conflicts, and optimization opportunities

plugins.name: pew-style
plugins.description: Design language migration analysis — compare app styling against a target reference and produce a phased migration plan

plugins.name: pew-react-audit
plugins.description: Comprehensive code quality audit — TypeScript patterns, security, duplication, complexity, debt, and remediation roadmap

plugins.name: pew-test-audit
plugins.description: Comprehensive test suite quality audit — tautological tests, over-mocking, flaky tests, coverage gaps, and remediation

plugins.name: pew-ux-audit
plugins.description: Comprehensive UX/UI audit — user goals, implementation review, pattern research, 12-layer evaluation, and improvement proposals
